items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: And I can see Lou Saino on trombone, you, Francis Murray, Tom Brown, and I can't see anybody else.

ctx.x: He used to tune piano. He was a professor in college and put it down there. There's Dick Allen right here.

Yeah, I can see Rawson Crawford's taking your picture. And in the picture up above that, Herbert Otto was recording. I made notes on that. Let's see. WNOE was broadcasting from the jazz club then. And I can see Lou Saino on trombone, you, Francis Murray, Tom Brown, and I can't see anybody else. Familiar faces.
This is as close as I've got to him. Yeah. You know what I'm talking about, huh? Yeah, I'll hurt.
